title: DaringMeister's Vanilla+
description: My take at a Vanilla+ modpack for Minecraft!
body:
**DaringMeister's Vanilla+** is a modpack aiming to breathe a little more life into your vanilla world. Everything is client side and no mods add any unfair advantages (aside from REI and Mouse Tweaks), therefore this modpack is a purely cosmetic upgrade to the base game. No new overbearing mechanics, absurd tools, insane biomes or otherwise. This is Minecraft with a fresh coat of paint!

This modpack was thrown together only with the intent to make vanilla Minecraft, or the base game look or appeal to the senses better. From small changes to resources to large animation updates alongside minor QoL fixes, the base game stays the same while the experience will look and feel different, and perhaps better.
